purpose: Single-security accounting input cross-check, not a stock ranking or return
method: Selective pyarrow and fsspec read: permno, yyyymm, DelDRC; filter PERMNO 12490 and 202403; whole-file hash not recomputed.
comparison: equal as Python double at shown precision
limits: One ratio can match under more than one set of inputs; source values, mapped fiscal periods and exact build are not independently verified.
SEC comparative values and provider data are retrospective, not proof of what was available in March 2024.
PERMNO-to-IBM name is corroborated but SEC CIK and share-class linkage are not independently proven.

DelDRC covers current deferred revenue scaled by average assets; CBOperProf also uses noncurrent deferred revenue and other components, so this does not establish its overall numerator or denominator.
No securities ranking, returns or trading actions were calculated.
